comment: No source is published. The allpass frequency is the clamped control times 777 plus 61, so 61Hz to 838Hz. The emphasis control is inverted inside the module: the coefficient handed to the phaser is a half minus half the knob minus a twentieth of the jack, clamped to 0.01 to 0.5, so raising the knob lowers the coefficient. None of the panel lettering names a control; the names used here are the maker's own, from the tooltips.
